5409.text: Hudson's agent revealed Tuesday that the tight end sustained a torn pectoral in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Dolphins and is expected to miss the rest of the season, Charlie Clifford of WLWT News 5 Cincinnati reports.

6904.text: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

11058.text: Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

5927.text: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

12521.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Friday that Arroyo (shoulder) underwent surgery and will likely be out for the rest of the season, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

6826.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet out for season after knee injury vs. Patriots. Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.

11034.text: Cardinals WR Jalen Brooks to miss rest of season with wrist injury. Cardinals wide receiver Jalen Brooks posted on social media Monday that he will miss the rest of the season with a wrist injury.

11592.text: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

12536.text: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

4454.text: Bourne (ankle) is expected to miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reports.

7083.text: Huntley (toe) has reportedly sustained a season-ending turf toe injury, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

4219.text: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

10232.text: Coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Wilson is out for the season due to a fracture in his neck, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

6011.text: Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right throwing elbow last Sunday at Seattle and is slated to undergo season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

11564.text: Sources: Patriots fear Drake Maye has broken ankle, could miss rest of season. The Patriots are concerned that Drake Maye sustained a fractured ankle, sources told ESPN, an injury that could sideline the star QB for the rest of the season.

2744.text: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

2743.text: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

8478048.text: Shesterkin will require surgery and a lengthy rehab process to address his season-ending right knee injury, Vince Z. Mercogliano of The Athletic reports Sunday.

700327.text: Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer announced Monday that Herrera (elbow) has been diagnosed with a torn UCL and will miss the remainder of the season, Jack Janes of MLB.com reports.

702303.text: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Wednesday that Martin (elbow) has been ruled out for the remainder of the season, Meghan Montemurro of the Chicago Tribune reports.

677053.text: Nardi (elbow) is slated to undergo season-ending surgery Friday, Christina De Nicola of MLB.com reports.

683232.text: Mears (shoulder) was diagnosed with thoracic outlet syndrome Saturday and will undergo season-ending surgery, MLB.com reports.

676962.text: Brown (neck) has been ruled out for the remainder of the season, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.

646240.text: Devers (abdomen) is expected to undergo season-ending surgery Tuesday, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

664854.text: President of baseball operations Mike Elias said Saturday that Helsley (elbow) will be shut down for the remainder of the season, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.

670059.text: Holderman will undergo season-ending surgery on his right wrist, Zack Meisel of The Athletic reports.

700242.text: Sweeney will undergo season-ending shoulder surgery this week, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.

676710.text: Crawford (forearm) is expected to remain on the injured list for the rest of the season, Jen McCaffrey of The Athletic reports.

691441.text: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo told reporters Monday that Mena underwent surgery on his right shoulder and will be sidelined for the rest of the season, Jack Sommers of SI.com reports.

701581.text: Festa (shoulder) will undergo a season-ending double surgery Wednesday, Dan Hayes of The Athletic reports.
